title: Blue Lock Anime Canon Question Bank
adaptationBoundary: Officially released Blue Lock anime episodes through Season 2 (overall episode 38, the 2024 Blue Lock vs. U-20 Japan season) plus the released 2024 anime film BLUE LOCK THE MOVIE -EPISODE NAGI-. Excludes all manga-only developments, later announced/unreleased seasons, and unreleased material. Episode Nagi is treated only for its released film continuity and its Nagi-perspective retelling of the early project.
notes: Original wording; each item targets one objectively checkable fact and has exactly four options.
Sources marked verified were cross-checked against the cited official anime/film pages or Crunchyroll released-anime guides; episode metadata was cross-checked against the released episode list.
No review items were necessary; no manga-only or unreleased facts are used.
